name: suggest-scalability
description: Decide whether a Cardano project needs Layer 2 / scaling at all, and if so which approach and topology fits — then route to the bundled implementation docs. Covers the L1-first sufficiency check (including the Leios throughput horizon), Hydra Head (the only mainnet-ready L2) vs Mithril vs in-development rollups (Midgard, Gummiworm), and Hydra topology selection (basic 2-party, delegated head, managed, star-shaped). Triggers: "do I need Layer 2", "which L2", "scale my dApp", "Hydra vs rollup", "Midgard", "Gummiworm", "state channel", "payment channel", "sidechain", "increase throughput", "sub-second finality", "which Hydra topology", "off-chain scaling", "reduce fees at scale".
